result.api_summary:
Module siphon.wdm — WDM system helpers.

Constants:
- C_UM_GHZ = 2.99792458e5 — speed of light in um*GHz so f[GHz] = C_UM_GHZ / wl[um].
- TUNING_EFFICIENCY_NM_PER_MW = 0.25 — typical Si microring heater efficiency (nm/mW).

class ChannelPlan (frozen dataclass):
- centers_um: tuple[float, ...] — channel centers in um, auto-sorted ascending, validated non-empty/positive.
- classmethod cwdm4() -> ChannelPlan — CWDM4 MSA plan: 1.271/1.291/1.311/1.331 um.
- classmethod lr4() -> ChannelPlan — 100GBASE-LR4 LAN-WDM 800 GHz grid: 1.29556/1.30005/1.30458/1.30914 um.
- classmethod dwdm(center_um: float, spacing_ghz: float, n_channels: int) -> ChannelPlan — uniform frequency grid centered on f(center_um), converted to wavelengths.
- spacing_nm() -> np.ndarray — adjacent channel spacings in nm (length n-1).
- as_frequencies_thz() -> np.ndarray — channel frequencies in THz, same order as centers_um.
- span_nm() -> float — first-to-last wavelength span in nm.

Functions:
- ring_bank_channel_count_limit(fsr_nm: float, channel_spacing_nm: float, guard_channels: int = 1) -> int — max(floor(fsr/spacing) - guard, 0).
- tuning_power_mw(detune_nm: float, efficiency_nm_per_mw: float = 0.25) -> float — |detune| / efficiency, in mW.
- expected_tuning_power_mw(fsr_nm: float, efficiency_nm_per_mw: float = 0.25) -> float — mean lock power (FSR/4)/efficiency; derivation (uniform offset over FSR, nearest-order wrap gives mean FSR/4) in docstring.
- resonance_shift_nm_per_k(wl_um: float, ng: float, dneff_dT: float = 1.86e-4*0.85) -> float — dlambda/dT = wl * (dneff/dT)/ng in nm/K; default is Si dn/dT scaled by 0.85 confinement factor.
- aggregate_crosstalk_db(per_channel_isolation_db: float, n_aggressors: int) -> float — worst-case incoherent sum 10*log10(n*10^(-iso/10)), returns negative dB; isolation given as positive dB.
- laser_grid_check(plan: ChannelPlan, ring_fsr_nm: float) -> None — raises ValueError if plan span > FSR, UserWarning if span > 0.9*FSR.
result.notes: Conventions chosen: ChannelPlan stores centers in um (per toolkit units rule) and sorts ascending on construction; spacing_nm() returns the array of adjacent spacings (not a scalar) since DWDM grids are slightly non-uniform in wavelength. dwdm() centers the frequency grid on f(center_um), so for even n_channels no channel sits exactly at center_um (channels straddle it symmetrically in frequency). laser_grid_check warns above 90% FSR utilization and raises above 100%; threshold documented in the docstring. tuning_power_mw uses |detune| (linear heater model; sign convention documented). No S-parameter models in this module — all helpers are scalar/system-level, so the ports/s_params convention does not apply. Did not touch __init__.py or pyproject.toml; integrator must export siphon.wdm if package-level re-export is wanted. No other files created; tests directory was newly created to hold tests/test_wdm.py (pyproject already sets testpaths=["tests"]). 26 tests pass via `uv run pytest tests/test_wdm.py -q`.

result.api_summary: No library API added (test-only task). Tests cover: siphon.materials — n_si/n_sio2/n_sin(wavelength_um), index(material, wl), group_index_material(material, wl), DN_DT_* constants; siphon.waveguide — slab_neffs(n_core, n_top, n_bot, thickness_um, wl, polarization), Waveguide(width_um, height_um, slab_um, core, cladding, box).neff/.group_index/.dispersion_ps_nm_km, bend_loss_db_per_90deg(radius_um).
result.notes: All 49 tests green (uv run pytest tests/test_materials.py tests/test_waveguide.py -q). Verified values before setting tolerances: n_si(1.55)=3.47758, n_sio2=1.44402, n_sin=1.99628, ng_si=3.5950, slab 220nm TE0=2.84934, strip TE=2.4930, TM=1.8481, ng=4.0200, bend(1um)=0.08611 — all match the physics targets. No library bugs found. Two task-spec expectations were physically wrong and were adjusted: (1) a 10 nm SYMMETRIC Si/SiO2 slab does guide TM0 (neff=1.44445) because the symmetric slab fundamental has no cutoff — this is correct behavior; the [] no-mode case is tested with an air-top ASYMMETRIC 10 nm slab (returns [] for both TE and TM), plus core-below-cladding and zero-thickness cases. (2) A 100x100 nm symmetric strip does NOT raise (EIM returns neff=1.4643; symmetric EIM always finds a mode), so the no-mode ValueError test uses Waveguide(0.5, 0.03, cladding="sin") — asymmetric vertical stack, verified to raise for both TE and TM. Extra analytic anchors included: symmetric-slab TE mode count formula M=1+floor(2t*sqrt(nc^2-ns^2)/lambda) (predicts 7 modes at t=1.5um, matches solver), wide-guide (10 um) EIM limit converging to the vertical slab index from below, and asymmetric 0.5 um slab having strictly fewer modes (2 vs 3) than symmetric. Known EIM bias documented in test docstring: EIM TE neff 2.49 vs ~2.44 full-vector; tests target the EIM value per task. Waveguide instances are cached via lru_cache on a frozen dataclass — no issues observed.

result.api_summary:
class siphon.circuit.Circuit:
- add(name: str, model) -> None — register a model instance (validates unique name, ports/s_params protocol, unique port names).
- connect(a: tuple[str, str], b: tuple[str, str]) -> None — join two (instance, port) pairs; each port usable at most once; ValueError on reuse or self-connection; KeyError on unknown instance/port.
- expose(external_name: str, port: tuple[str, str]) -> None — name an instance port as an external port; ValueError on duplicate external name or reused port.
- external_ports: tuple[str, ...] — property; external names in expose() order (== S-matrix port order).
- s_params(wl: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray — external S-matrix shape (len(wl), n_ext, n_ext), complex, b_i = sum_j S[k,i,j] a_j; wl in um. ValueError listing any dangling (unconnected+unexposed) ports; np.linalg.LinAlgError naming the wavelength index if (I - S_ii P) is singular (cond > 1e12). Uses np.linalg.solve, per-wavelength loop, formula S_ee + S_ei P (I - S_ii P)^-1 S_ie.
- transmission(wl, inport: str, outport: str) -> np.ndarray — complex field transmission b_out/a_in between external port names.
- transmission_db(wl, inport, outport) -> np.ndarray — power dB, 10*log10(|t|^2), -inf-safe.
result.notes: siphon.components did not exist, so tests/test_circuit.py defines self-contained stubs (Phase, dispersive Arm, ideal 4-port Coupler with through r=sqrt(1-kappa) and cross 1j*sqrt(kappa)). Tests cover: cascade == product of transmissions (plus no spurious reflections), MZI vs analytic C diag(t1,t2) C plus unitarity/energy conservation, all-pass ring vs closed form (r - L)/(1 - r L) plus on/off-resonance power bounds, reciprocity of an assembled lossy network, dangling-port and double-connect/expose errors, unknown-instance/port errors, and singular-loop detection (gain loop with 1 - rL = 0 raises LinAlgError naming wavelength index). Conventions chosen: port reference is (instance_name, port_name); singularity raises np.linalg.LinAlgError (dangling ports raise ValueError); scalar wl is accepted via np.atleast_1d (result still has a leading wavelength axis of 1); models' s_params return shapes are validated. Did not touch __init__.py or pyproject.toml — integrator must wire exports. Created the tests/ directory (it did not exist; pyproject already sets testpaths=["tests"]).

result.api_summary:
All models expose `ports: ClassVar[tuple[str, ...]]` and `s_params(wl: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray` of shape (len(wl), n_ports, n_ports), complex, reciprocal, unitary when lossless (except YBranch).

Classes (all @dataclass, in siphon.components):
- Straight(length_um, neff0, ng, loss_db_per_cm=0.0, wl0_um=1.55) — 2 ports ("in","out"); linearized dispersion neff(wl)=neff0+(wl-wl0)(neff0-ng)/wl0, phase exp(-1j*2*pi*neff*L/wl); classmethod from_waveguide(wg, length_um, loss_db_per_cm=0.0, wl0_um=1.55, mode="TE").
- DirectionalCoupler(coupling=0.5, loss_db=0.0) — 4 ports ("in0","in1","out0","out1"); t=sqrt(1-c) through, 1j*sqrt(c) cross, wavelength-flat.
- YBranch(excess_loss_db=0.0) — 3 ports ("in","out0","out1"), 50/50; power-conserving <=1, not unitary (documented).
- PhaseShifter(phase_rad=0.0, loss_db=0.0) — 2 ports, S21=amp*exp(-1j*phase).
- ThermalPhaseShifter(power_mw, p_pi_mw, loss_db=0.0) — property phase_rad = pi*power/p_pi.
- GratingCoupler(peak_il_db=4.0, bw_1db_nm=35.0, center_um=1.55) — Gaussian IL_db(wl)=peak+((wl-center)/(bw_um/2))^2; also method il_db(wl).
- RingAllPass(circumference_um, neff0, ng, kappa_power=0.1, loss_db_per_cm=0.0, wl0_um=1.55) — through=(t-a e^{i phi})/(1-t a e^{i phi}).
- RingAddDrop(circumference_um, neff0, ng, kappa1_power=0.1, kappa2_power=0.1, loss_db_per_cm=0.0, wl0_um=1.55) — 4 ports ("in","through","add","drop"), Bogaerts 2012 Eqs. 4-5, full reciprocal 4x4 with add->drop=(t2-t1 a e^{i phi})/D, add->through == in->drop, in<->add = 0.
- MZI(dl_um, neff0, ng, coupling_in=0.5, coupling_out=0.5, loss_db_per_cm=0.0, wl0_um=1.55) — 4 ports as DC; analytic M = C_out @ diag(arm phases) @ C_in.

Helpers: ring_fsr_um(wl_um, ng, circumference_um) = wl^2/(ng*L); loaded_q(wl_um, fwhm_um) = wl/fwhm; finesse(fsr, fwhm) = fsr/fwhm.
result.notes: All 19 new tests pass (unitarity of DC/MZI/rings/Straight, MZI extinction wavelengths + FSR, ring resonance positions from the closed form wl_m = ng*L/(m - s*L) with s=(neff0-ng)/wl0, all-pass critical-coupling extinction, add-drop unitarity when lossless, drop-peak value against the analytic k1*k2*a/(1-t1*t2*a)^2, FSR-vs-peak-spacing scan, GC 1-dB bandwidth, hand-computed Straight phase); full repo suite 103 passed. Conventions chosen: ports is a ClassVar (not an __init__ field); no back-reflection modeled anywhere (all diagonal S = 0); ring formulas use exp(+1j*phi) per Bogaerts 2012 while propagation elsewhere uses exp(-1j*beta*L) — magnitudes/resonances identical, documented in the module docstring; MZI models only the differential arm (lengths dl_um and 0), so loss_db_per_cm acts on the dl arm only and common arm length/loss is factored out (documented); GratingCoupler S21 is real (no transmission phase modeled); s_params accepts scalars via np.atleast_1d and rejects non-positive wavelengths. No files outside the two owned files were touched (integrator must wire __init__.py exports).

result.api_summary:
siphon.link — IM-DD link-budget engine (all closed-form).

Constants: NOISE_BANDWIDTH_FRACTION = 0.75 (noise BW as fraction of baud).

BER/Q:
- q_from_ber(target_ber: float, levels: int) -> float — per-eye Q for PAM-M via SER = 2(1-1/M)Q(q), BER = SER/log2(M) (Gray); scipy erfcinv.
- ber_from_q(q: float, levels: int) -> float — exact inverse.

Components (frozen dataclasses):
- Laser(power_dbm, wpe, rin_db_hz, launch_reference="fiber") — per-line power at documented reference plane; wpe in (0,1].
- Modulator(insertion_loss_db, extinction_ratio_db, energy_fj_per_bit); property modulation_loss_db = -10log10((1+1/ER)/2), 3.01 dB at inf ER.
- Photodiode(responsivity_a_per_w, dark_current_na=10.0) — dark current carried but unused in thermal-limited model.
- Tia(input_noise_pa_per_sqrt_hz, bandwidth_ghz, energy_fj_per_bit).
- Signaling(rate_gbd, levels=4, target_ber=2.4e-4); properties bits_per_symbol, bit_rate_gbps, q_factor.
- LossElement(name: str, loss_db: float).

Sensitivity/penalties (all return dB):
- receiver_sensitivity_oma_dbm(pd, tia, sig) -> float — OMA_outer = 2 q (M-1) i_n / R, i_n = S_i sqrt(0.75*baud), returned in dBm.
- er_penalty_db(er_db) — 10log10((ER+1)/(ER-1)); 0 at inf; ValueError for er_db<=0.
- rin_penalty_db(rin_db_hz, rate_gbd, q, levels) — -5log10(1-(2 q r (M-1))^2), r=sqrt(RIN_lin*0.75*baud); ValueError when unreachable.
- crosstalk_penalty_db(agg_crosstalk_db) — -10log10(1-10^(xt/10)); ValueError for xt>=0.

LinkBudget(laser, modulator, path: list[LossElement], photodiode, tia, signaling, penalties_db: dict[str,float]|None=None):
properties average_launch_power_dbm, launched_oma_dbm (ER-limited), path_loss_db, received_oma_dbm, rin_penalty_db, sensitivity_oma_dbm (thermal + ER + RIN + explicit penalties), margin_db; report() -> str aligned waterfall (delta column + running dBm column, TX/path/RX/margin sections).

Energy:
- energy_per_bit_pj(link, n_lanes, laser_shared_by=1, thermal_tuning_mw_per_lane=0.0, serdes_pj_per_bit=4.0) -> dict with keys laser/modulator/tia/tuning/serdes/total, pJ/bit; laser electrical = optical/wpe, ceil(n_lanes/laser_shared_by) lasers.

Presets (illustrative, per-field justifying comments):
- preset_pluggable_dr4() — 53.125 GBd PAM4 (106.25G/lane), Si-photonic MZM, grating-coupled, 500 m SMF; margin ~+7.0 dB, ~6.2 pJ/bit with 4 pJ/bit serdes.
- preset_cpo_optical_io() — 32 Gb/s NRZ, external laser via fiber, ring modulator, edge-coupled; margin ~+11.4 dB, ~2.3 pJ/bit with 0.5 pJ/bit serdes.
result.notes: 31 new tests; full suite 134 passed (no other files touched, no __init__/pyproject edits). Conventions/caveats: (1) Budget is tracked in the OMA domain; launched OMA is ER-limited (factor 1-1/ER folded into modulation loss + avg->OMA conversion) AND er_penalty_db is added on the sensitivity side per the spec — documented as the standard conservative composition (at infinite ER both vanish, so the model is self-consistent in the limit). (2) On the required 'PAM4 vs NRZ = 20log10(3) ~ 9.54 dB' test: a factor (M-1)=3 in OMA (an optical power) is 10log10(3)=4.77 dB in dBm; 9.54 dB is the equivalent electrical (current-squared) penalty. The test verifies both exactly at matched per-eye q (2*optical_diff == 20log10(3)) and approximately (±0.2 dB) at equal target BER, with an explanatory comment. (3) rin_penalty_db derivation: RIN noise evaluated at the top level, Agrawal eq. 4.7.3 structure generalized to PAM-M; unreachable condition 2 q r (M-1) >= 1 raises ValueError. (4) levels must be a power of two >= 2 (Gray-coding assumption). (5) No S-parameter interface: link.py has no wave-model classes, so the ports/s_params convention does not apply. (6) energy_per_bit_pj serdes default is 4.0 pJ/bit (LR/DSP-class); presets' numbers are explicitly marked illustrative in docstrings.

result.api_summary: No library API — three runnable demo scripts, each with main() -> int and `if __name__ == "__main__"` entry. 01_waveguide_explorer.py: 220 nm SOI strip width sweep 0.35-0.7 um (neff/ng TE+TM tables via Waveguide/EIM), single-mode boundary scan via slab_neffs, bend-loss table; core modules only. 02_ring_wdm_filter.py: CWDM4 ring-bank demux — circumference from target 80 nm FSR via ng, integer-mode snap to each channel, FSR/Q/IL table and 4x4 crosstalk matrix from RingAddDrop.s_params spectra, capacity/aliasing checks and thermal tuning via wdm helpers (ring_bank_channel_count_limit, laser_grid_check, resonance_shift_nm_per_k, tuning_power_mw, expected_tuning_power_mw, aggregate_crosstalk_db). 03_cpo_vs_pluggable.py: prints both preset link.report() waterfalls, margin comparison table, energy_per_bit_pj breakdown table (pluggable serdes 4.0 pJ/bit vs CPO 1.0 + 2 mW/lane tuning), and per-51.2T-switch power/$ framing (64x800G, $0.10/kWh, PUE 1.3, 5-yr). All three try-import matplotlib and save PNGs to examples/out/ (01_waveguide_explorer.png, 02_ring_demux_spectra.png, 03_energy_per_bit.png), silently skipping if absent.
result.notes: VERIFIED RUNNING: all three scripts, both with and without matplotlib (uv run python and uv run --with matplotlib), all exit 0; PNGs visually inspected (validated categorical palette #2a78d6/#eb6834/#1baf7a/#eda100, direct labels, single axis per panel). Note the components/circuit/link/wdm modules had already landed in src/siphon when I ran, so scripts 2-3 were verified against the REAL modules, not stubs, and I matched the actual signatures found there (e.g. ChannelPlan.centers_um; aggregate_crosstalk_db(iso_db, n_aggressors); expected_tuning_power_mw(fsr_nm)). Drift protection retained: ImportError guard at each main() entry with a clear 'not built yet' message, and wdm helper calls in 02 go through a small attempt() wrapper that prints '[skipped] <call>: <error>' instead of crashing. Conventions: examples/out/ created on demand by the plot helpers (.gitkeep committed, PNGs deleted after verification to keep the tree clean). Physics caveats printed in-script: EIM single-mode boundary is conservative (TE1 at ~320 nm vs ~450-500 nm vectorial), CWDM 80 nm FSR ring design is deliberately shown as hostile (R~0.8 um, 0.5 dB/round-trip bend loss, 80 mW/ring expected tuning) to motivate DWDM ring banks. No test file was assigned to this task; 'tests passing' = all assigned scripts run green. No other repo files touched.
